in_sanskrit.name: Kathika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Purity, Cleansing
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kathika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Katha' meaning 'story' or 'account', Kathika represents purity and cleansing. In Hindu mythology, Kathika is the name of a constellation believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. It is also the name of a revered goddess, symbolizing the purifying power of water and knowledge.
